fixes.explanation: True. Some believers from the party of the Pharisees stood up and declared, “The Gentiles must be circumcised and required to obey the law of Moses.” (Acts 15:5) They say it out loud, in front of everybody. Now the council has a real question on its table.
Tarsus doesn't show up in this part of the story, friend. The text names Jerusalem instead (Acts 15:2). Mixing up a city on the map happens to the best of us, so no worries.
